text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright... finished the shopping.
Time to get to training—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oops, my glasses... If they come off this easily,
I won't be able to run... Guess I should get them serviced.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Valued customer, how does it feel after the adjustments?
I altered it specifically for running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a sporting goods pro, so efficient.
At this rate, I'll even make it in time for trai, ning...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me, it feels a bit tight.
Could you loosen the hinge for me?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Now my nose feels uncomfortable...!
I need to adjust the height of the nose pads too—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "B-But is it already time for training...? Good grief, I won't be able to concentrate like this."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. In fact, if we leave this discomfort unaddressed,
it'll only reduce the efficiency of our training."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In other words, this will affect your races too!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then...
Shall we proceed with the additional maintenance?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Pour everything into adjusting my glasses,
and make up for the late practice later—this is the optimal solution!

And so, Biwa Hayahide ended up
neglecting her training...
